title: Closure of Claimant Identity Verification Cases
content:
Claimant Identity Verification cases are closed by the system, and a closed case stays closed.

## Rule

1. A case closes when the linked claim is closed or withdrawn, whatever the case status other than opened or in progress; an expired case also closes when its late completion window passes.
2. A closed case is never reopened; a verified case that closed still counts for verification reuse.

## When each status closes

| Case status | Closes when |
|---|---|
| verified | the linked claim is closed or withdrawn |
| failed | the linked claim is closed or withdrawn |
| expired | the linked claim is closed or withdrawn, or the late completion window passes |
| fraud confirmed | the fraud case on the impostor claim is concluded, or the linked claim is closed or withdrawn |

The date the case closed is recorded on it.

## Points of judgement

- **Closed means final.** No action reopens a closed case, whatever its status was before closing.
- **Verified cases keep counting.** A verified case that has since closed is still counted when a later claim is tested for verification reuse.
- **Expired cases (hypothetical dates).** An expired case whose late completion window ends on 21 April and which is not reopened closes once that window passes, even while the linked claim remains open.
